Passenger.name: PASSENGER
Passenger.card: Has no special ability. Wins by voting-off the Saboteur.
Passenger.tip:
Passengers have no special abilities and must rely on their powers of deduction to survive! Be on the lookout for players trying to eliminate those you trust.
Pay close attention to round results, especially any special abilities that were used.

Captain.name: CAPTAIN
description: Each round, you may cast a second vote.
You may cast a second vote for the same player, choose someone else, or withhold your second vote altogether.
Captain.card: May vote twice each round. Wins by voting-off the Saboteur.
Captain.tip:
You have a very powerful special ability, so use it wisely. Do your best to vote out the players you don't trust and also stay alive yourself.
It is helpful to have others who know you are the Captain so that you may vote out the right player but it is also dangerous to be known by the Stowaways.
Captain.prompt: Who else would you like to vote off Saboteur Rock?

Medic.name: MEDIC
description: Each round, you may play a Satchel of Safety (SOS) that grants a player immunity from vote-off and execution. Any votes cast for the saved player will not count, and the player with the second-highest number of votes will be eliminated.

You may play the SOS on yourself, another player, or withhold your saving ability altogether. You may play the SOS on the same player for two consecutive rounds; however, doing so will forfeit your ability to use the SOS for one round after.
Everyone will know if a player is saved.
Medic.card: May save a player each round with a Satchel of Safety. If the Satchel of Safety is used on the same player in two consecutive rounds, this ability is disabled for the following round. Wins by voting-off the Saboteur.
Medic.tip:
You have a very powerful special ability, so use it wisely. Do your best to save those you trust but also to stay alive yourself.
It is helpful to have others who know you are the Medic so that you may save the right player but it is also dangerous to be known by the Stowaways.
Medic.prompt: Who would you like to save this round?

Professor.name: PROFESSOR
Professor.card: Knows whether their vote was the same as the Saboteur's. Wins by voting-off the Saboteur.
Professor.tip:
It's a dangerous business to be voting for the same person as the Saboteur. It's very unlikely that the Saboteur will be voting for a Stowaway.
Pay close attention to who is claiming to vote for whom as you never know when you may vote with the Saboteur.

Detective.name: DETECTIVE
Detective.card: Investigates one card from the Graveyard during the Marooning. Wins by voting-off the Saboteur.
Detective.tip:
You gain information before the game even starts but if/when you reveal that information is up to you.
You may want to reveal your information to gain trust and spread the word lest it be brought with you to a watery grave. You may also want to withhold the information in an attempt to catch a Stowaway in a lie. Beware that revealing you are the detective may put a target on your back if you are seen as trustworthy.

President.name: PRESIDENT
description: You may veto all votes and actions in a round once per game. All votes cast and all actions played will have no effect in the vetoed round.
Everyone will know if a round is vetoed.
President.card: May veto a vote. Known by the Turncoat. Wins by voting-off the Saboteur.
President.tip:
As the President, it's important to stay alive - if you are voted out or killed, the Turncoat will change teams to the Stowaways.
The Turncoat knows your identity, and if they choose to align with the Stowaways they may try to vote you out.
The President has the power to veto just ONE vote, so use it wisely. If you think that the vote may have an undesirable result, you may want to veto.
President.prompt: Would you like to veto this round? You may only do this once.

Turncoat.name: TURNCOAT
Turncoat.card: Has no special ability. Knows the President. Becomes a Stowaway if the President is voted off.
Turncoat.tip:
Pay close attention to the President. If they are eliminated, you become part of the Stowaway team.
The Turncoat may attempt to reveal themselves to the Stowaways but beware, if the Passengers learn of the Turncoat's identity they may vote them out.

Saboteur.name: SABOTEUR
Saboteur.card: Wants to vote-off as many players as possible while keeping identity hidden. Wins by gaining the majority with the Saboteur crew.
Saboteur.tip: This is the most important role in the game! Do your best to stay alive and play it safe. Use your fellow Stowaways to redirect suspicion and pool your votes to slowly pick off Passengers.

Accomplice.name: ACCOMPLICE
Accomplice.card: Knows the Saboteur. Wins if the Saboteur wins.
Accomplice.tip: The Accomplice has no special ability. Do your best to redirect suspicion from the Saboteur and work with other Stowaways to vote out potential threats.

Executioner.name: EXECUTIONER
description: You may execute one player during the game. The Medic's Satchel of Safety (SOS) and President's Veto can save this player.
You may play this ability on any player, or withhold your execution ability altogether.
Everyone will know if a player is executed.
Executioner.card: Knows the Saboteur. May execute one player during the game after the first round. Wins if the Saboteur wins.
Executioner.tip: The executioner may only use their ability ONCE, so be sure that you don't miss. The executioner can be blocked by either the Medic's SOS or the President's veto. If the execution is blocked, it CANNOT be used again. Plan accordingly!
Executioner.prompt: Who would you like to execute this round?

Silencer.name: SILENCER
description: Each round, you may block the vote(s) of one player.
Everyone will know what player's vote was blocked.
Silencer.card: Knows the Saboteur. May cancel one player's vote each round. Wins if the Saboteur wins.
Silencer.tip: The Silencer has a powerful ability that can be used every round. Blocking a vote can be helpful but the blocked player will be revealed along with the votes. This can give Passengers and idea of who the Stowaways are targeting and who to trust (a blocked player is less likely to be a Stowaway).
Silencer.prompt: Who would you like to block this round?

Ghost.name: GHOST
Ghost.card: Knows the Saboteur. Assumes a role from the Graveyard during the Marooning. Wins if the Saboteur wins.
Ghost.tip: The Ghost can be played multiple different ways depending on which ability the Ghost possesses. Use your ability wisely. It's in your best interest to share which role was revealed to you during the marooning to other Stowaways.
